about.headline: Two Families. One Vision.
about.story: FTS Visions was founded by Szilárd Tóth and András Fodor — two friends who believe every small business deserves a professional online presence, regardless of budget. We are fathers, entrepreneurs, and builders. The name FTS Visions carries the initials of our families — and the vision we have for the businesses we serve. We speak Romanian, Hungarian, and English — so we can serve your business in the language you're most comfortable with.
